title: BMO-Type characterizations and endpoint estimates for commutators of intrinsic square functions on Orlicz-Hardy spaces
summary: The commutators of intrinsic square functions associated with the intrinsic Littlewood--Paley $g$-function, the intrinsic $g_λ^{*}$-function and the intrinsic Lusin area function can be used to characterize BMO-type function spaces through their boundedness properties. In this paper, we show that, for $b\in {\rm BMO}(\mathbb{R}^{n})$, the boundedness of each of these commutators from the Musielak--Orlicz Hardy space $H^{\varphi}(\mathbb{R}^{n})$ to $L^{\varphi}(\mathbb{R}^{n})$ is equivalent to $b\in {\rm BMO}_{\varphi}(\mathbb{R}^{n})$ (a nontrivial subspace of $\rm{BMO}(\mathbb{R}^{n})$),…
